items.name: ArrowBytesMap
items.signature: struct ArrowBytesMap<O, V> where O: OffsetSizeTrait, V: Debug + PartialEq + Eq + Clone + Copy + Default
items.summary: Optimized map for storing Arrow "bytes" types (`String`, `LargeString`, `Binary`, and `LargeBinary`) values that can produce the set of keys on output as `GenericBinaryArray` without copies.

methods.name: insert_if_new
methods.signature: fn insert_if_new<MP, OP>(&mut self, values: &ArrayRef, make_payload_fn: MP, observe_payload_fn: OP) where MP: FnMut(Option<&[u8]>) -> V, OP: FnMut(V)
methods.summary: Inserts each value from `values` into the map, invoking `payload_fn` for each value if *not* already present, deferring the allocation of the payload until it is needed.

methods.name: into_state
methods.summary: Converts this set into a `StringArray`, `LargeStringArray`, `BinaryArray`, or `LargeBinaryArray` containing each distinct value that was inserted. This is done without copying the values.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Total number of entries (including null, if present)

methods.name: size
methods.summary: Return the total size, in bytes, of memory used to store the data in this set, not including `self`

methods.name: take
methods.summary: Return the contents of this map and replace it with a new empty map with the same output type
